context_for_next_testing_agent: Both v35 fixes (tenant isolation bypass + purge dialog gate) verified. Regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_v35_quarantine_queue_tenant.py; new class TestV35TenantBypassFix has 7 tests that specifically guard against re-introduction of the ?license_key=MASTER escalation. Positive-path master auth (header, cookie, MASTER_IP legacy) all validated. Scope meta now returned in both exim and mock branches, so mock-vs-exim gating is not required for the tenant assertion.
rca of the issue: PRIOR: Legacy fallback branches in _resolve_tenant / _tenant_scope granted is_master=True whenever license_key_arg matched MASTER_LICENSE_KEY, with NO caller identity check — any unauthenticated caller could escalate by sending ?license_key=MASTER_KEY in the URL. FIX: The legacy branch now additionally requires the caller IP (via X-Forwarded-For or request.client.host) to equal MASTER_IP (89.19.15.58) from env. Header/cookie paths remain unchanged. This preserves legacy WHM-plugin behaviour (WHM box has the fixed public IP) while closing the query-string escalation vector. Frontend purge dialog RCA: PurgeAllDialog previously had button.disabled but no visual/pointer-events state; now uses conditional class with pointer-events-none, opacity-50, cursor-not-allowed and aria-disabled when !canGo (canGo = confirm.toLowerCase() === 'sil').
